title: Computer-assisted near-optimality certificate for Kerdock/MUB cubature
theorem: For the dimension-256, depth-32 infinite-width normalized ReLU ensemble kernel, every network-independent linear cubature rule supported on at most 66,048 points, with nonnegative weights summing to one, has ensemble mean-squared integration error at least the certified optimum lower bound. The uniform 66,048-point Kerdock/MUB rule has ensemble MSE no more than the certified multiplicative factor above that optimum.
randomized_rule_corollary: The same lower bound holds after averaging over a randomized rule provided the rule's nodes, weights, and random seed are independent of the realized network. It does not cover network-adaptive nodes or weights, pilot-sample adaptation, nonlinear estimators, signed weights, or finite-width-specific estimators.

included: deterministic nodes and weights fixed independently of the network
randomized nodes and weights whose randomness is independent of the network
infinite-width depth-32 normalized ReLU ensemble kernel in dimension 256
excluded: nodes selected from realized network weights
weights selected from realized network weights or observed activations
analytic-plus-residual estimators depending on the network

human_readable_conclusion: Kerdock is certified to be at most 0.0233655010294813770660200185981719050338763170397955080034412066510055262751900% above the optimum within the stated class.
